subject: Billing contact sync mode — email copy, portal UI or webhook push?
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwave.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: fred.liu@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing contact sync mode — email copy, portal UI or webhook push?

Hi Vivek / Kim,

We're finalizing how ClearWave will receive invoices from Redwood for the pilot (monthly usage + overage). AP asks whether Redwood can push invoices via a webhook (JSON payload + signed PDF attachment) directly into our AP system, rather than relying on the portal or standard email attachments. A few constraints from our side: we require a machine-readable tax_id line on every invoice, and PDFs must include a signature block for our PO reconciliation.

Quick questions:
- Can Redwood support a webhook push for each invoice (POST to our endpoint) with retry semantics?
- If we do webhook + PDF, will our AP still get an email copy for manual processing when needed?
- Any VAT tagging differences between portal-issued invoices and programmatic pushes?

We're open to portal enrollment if it's simpler, but we'd prefer API/webhook for automation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call to walk through requirements.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of Finance, ClearWave Analytics
Samantha.Green@clearwave.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: sample_invoice_signed.pdf (pdf, 285KB stub)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact sync mode — email copy, portal UI or webhook push?

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear summary.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can emit a POST webhook per invoice to a customer-managed endpoint with configurable retries/backoff and a 7-day retry window.
- We can send an email copy (PDF) to an AP mailbox as a fanout on webhook delivery success/failure.
- VAT tagging is consistent across delivery channels — the invoice payload includes an explicit VAT_breakdown field when applicable.

A few asks from our side to lock behavior:
1) Please confirm the target webhook security: HMAC header (recommended) or mTLS?
2) Who should be the billing_contact (email) to receive failure notifications and manual copies?
3) Are there any PO number formatting quirks we should enforce in the invoice PDF metadata?

Kim (cc'd), can you weigh in on our recommended default (portal as source-of-truth vs webhook-first with email backup)? If we go webhook-first we should document a short SLA for re-delivery and support escalation.

If OK I'll propose a short MAD (mutual action doc) and a sample payload schema.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact sync mode — email copy, portal UI or webhook push?

Thanks for laying this out. My recommendation based on similar customers: use the portal as the canonical invoice store (papertrail, audit), but enable webhook pushes to the customer's AP system on emission. That gives you both automation and a human-auditable source.

Operational detail proposal:
- Portal = source-of-truth: every invoice issued is stored in the customer's portal tenant with full metadata and VAT evidence attached.
- Webhook push = fanout: on issue we POST a JSON payload to the customer endpoint. If POST succeeds (2xx), we'll fan out a signed PDF to the AP mailbox you provide. If POST fails after retries, we create a portal incident and send immediate email to billing_contact.
- Retry/backoff: exponential backoff with up to 8 attempts across 7 days.
- Security: recommend HMAC-SHA256 over a shared secret; we also support client TLS certs for customers that require mutual auth.
- PO handling: we can include both a PO_text field and a normalized PO_number field (strip non-digits) to improve matching.

Attached is a sample signed invoice template showing where we put tax_id and signature block in the PDF.

If ClearWave is comfortable with portal+webhook, the next steps are:
1) Confirm billing_contact for failure notifications (email) and AP mailbox for copies.
2) Provide webhook endpoint + preferred security flavor.
3) Sign a short integration appendix (I can send a JIRA + HubSpot link once confirmed).

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Customer Billing | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachment: sample_invoice_signed.pdf (pdf, 285KB stub)

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@clearwave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Fred Liu <fred.liu@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact sync mode — email copy, portal UI or webhook push?

Hi Kim / Vivek — thanks for the recommendation and the sample. ClearWave prefers the portal-as-SoT + webhook-fanout approach you outlined. A few confirmations below: 

1) Webhook endpoint and security
- Endpoint: https://integrations.clearwave.com/redwood/invoice-hook
- Security: HMAC-SHA256 header (X-CW-Signature) — we'll provide a key via secure vault.

2) AP mailbox for copies / failure notifications
- ap.invoices@clearwave.com (please CC ap.manager@clearwave.com on failures)

3) PO and tax requirements
- Our AP requires the invoice PDF show Tax ID: CW-987654321 on the header and the PDF must include a signature block (the sample you sent is fine).

4) Exceptions / timeline
- If there's a webhook failure we'll expect a portal incident and an email to ap.invoices within 2 hours of final retry failure.
- We do not support SFTP at this time; webhook preferred.

Attached is our AP contact sheet with endpoint test credentials (sensitive; will share via secure link after NDA-add).

Would appreciate a quick confirmation from your side on cutover date. We're targeting May 15 for first automated invoice.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Finance, ClearWave Analytics
Attachment: ClearWave_AP_details.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB stub)
